ls-integration-warning.title: LS Integration Warning
ls-integration-warning.description: SafeLMS Courses page demoing a Learning Studio integration-warning modal, with a V1/V2 switch comparing dialog variants.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Standard SafeLMS Reports view with report-type tabs, a Schedule Report section, and paginated results.

timeout-modal-SAFELMS-30656.title: Timeout Modal
timeout-modal-SAFELMS-30656.description: Session timeout warning modal with a countdown and Continue/Extend actions, including logged-out and session-extended states.

osha-report.title: OSHA Reporting
osha-report.description: OSHA completion dashboard — V1/V1.1 (course % complete + grouped Latest Module columns, Position/Location filters), V1.2 adds a dynamic status pie that drills into the selected Action Needed group, and V2 is the pre-update report.

certificate.title: Training Certificate
certificate.description: Print-ready Vector Solutions training-completion cert (mail-merge, one Letter landscape page) — V1 the CTLE-eligible template with full compliance block, V2 the lighter Child Abuse: Mandatory Reporting cert.

flow-map-test.title: Flow Map Test
flow-map-test.description: Design Toolbox test: pick a course, each branches into its own path (Fall Protection adds a gear check, Fire Safety a drill, HazCom goes straight to review) — wired to the flow map as three lanes.

completions-by-time-report.title: Completions by Time Report
completions-by-time-report.description: Completions by Time report rebuilt on vrf-report-view: filter drawer (date range, library, course, user status), 227-row grid with export.

self-serve-bulk-upload.title: Self-Serve Bulk Upload
self-serve-bulk-upload.description: Customer-facing bulk user import under the Employees tab (auto-sync assumed already set up): split-button entry → map columns → import settings → review by severity → run, plus the auto-sync failure path. Single canonical flow, now being built out against the PRD.

recommended-assignment-templates.title: Recommended Assignment Templates
recommended-assignment-templates.description: Low-tech state-compliance course guidance on the Training Plans page — V1 banner to the Vectoria chatbot, V2 banner out to an external Guide-PDF microsite (real new tab), V3 a collapsible compliance checklist of required courses, V4 a carousel of recommended-course banners with Assign / Already Done actions.

assignment-progress-reporting.title: Assignment Progress Reporting
assignment-progress-reporting.description: # Not Started / # In Progress counts on Training Compliance, Outstanding sub-statuses in Compliance by Employee, and a pie-chart Status column on Training Plans.
